title: Question 7.1d: Testing Individual Reviews - Loop Through Samples
instruction: This code tests the model on multiple example reviews to demonstrate how it works.
reveal: This loop goes through each review in the `sampleReviews` array. For each review, it extracts the review text (`sampleReviews[i][0]`) and the expected sentiment (`sampleReviews[i][1]`), makes a prediction, and compares the prediction to the expected result. This demonstrates the model working on real examples and shows how many it gets right.
